title: phyteuma michelii subsp. betonicifolium
intro: Phyteuma michelii subsp. betonicifolium, commonly known as Alpine Cottongrass, is a subspecies of flowering plant in the bellflower family, native to the mountainous regions of Europe. This plant is valued for its medicinal properties, which include health benefits such as anti-inflammatory and antioxidant effects, helping to alleviate symptoms of respiratory issues and skin conditions. The therapeutic actions of Phyteuma michelii subsp. betonicifolium include expectorant and mucolytic properties, making it useful in treating coughs and bronchitis. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
